name: titech-community-capital-backend
description: TITech Community Capital backend — enterprise community-finance control plane for tenancy, identity, financial events, ledger, provider-neutral payments, settlement/reconciliation, consent, risk governance, operations and capital connectivity.
author: Igune Justine Robert, TITech Community Capital LTD - CEO/Founder/CTO/Senior Software Engineer

scripts.dev: nodemon --watch server.js --watch bootstrap --watch routes --watch middleware --watch config --watch services --watch models --watch controllers --watch modules --ext js,mjs,cjs,json --ignore node_modules --exec "node --enable-source-maps --max-old-space-size=4096 server.js"
scripts.dev:inspect: nodemon --watch server.js --watch bootstrap --watch routes --watch middleware --watch config --watch services --watch models --watch controllers --watch modules --ext js,mjs,cjs,json --ignore node_modules --exec "node --inspect --enable-source-maps --max-old-space-size=4096 server.js"
scripts.build: node -e "console.log('TITech Community Capital backend build validation complete - Node.js runtime requires no compilation.')"
scripts.check:syntax: node --check server.js && node --check bootstrap/ApplicationBootstrap.js && node --check bootstrap/routes.js && node --check bootstrap/observability.js && node --check bootstrap/resilience.js
scripts.check:esm: node --enable-source-maps --input-type=module -e "Promise.all([import('./bootstrap/observability.js'), import('./bootstrap/resilience.js')]).then(() => console.log('TITech ESM bootstrap modules loaded successfully.')).catch(error => { console.error('TITech ESM bootstrap module validation failed.'); console.error(error); console.error(error?.cause ?? 'No nested cause supplied.'); process.exitCode = 1; })"
scripts.check:bootstrap: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:esm
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check:syntax
scripts.quality:ci: npm run check && npm run test:ci
scripts.diagnose:routes: node --enable-source-maps --input-type=module -e "import('./routes/index.js').then(module => { console.log('TITech route module loaded successfully.'); console.log('Exports:', Object.keys(module)); }).catch(error => { console.error('TITech route module import failed.'); console.error(error); console.error('Cause:', error?.cause ?? 'No nested cause supplied.'); console.error('Cause stack:', error?.cause?.stack ?? 'No nested cause stack supplied.'); process.exitCode = 1; })"
scripts.prepare: node -e "console.log('TITech Community Capital backend dependencies prepared.')"
